race.comment: BEATTY (1) missed in the Karrakatta but won the Sires impressively before the break. His latest trial was impressive and he's shown he can sit off the pace and round them up. Drawn sticky, but he's the class runner of the field and he can pick up from where he left off. BIG RED ZOOM (3) held on to win the Simmonds by a nostril after having a dream run in the race. He was still good enough to win and turned in a strong rating in the process. Drawn out this time, but he won the main lead-up at start two and there's no reason why he can't keep winning. COS I AM (12) was building into the race nicely but hit a brick wall at a crucial stage and went to the line hard held. Better suited out to 1200m and with a better draw this time, she can show what she's capable of. GODSPEED (5) looks to have some class about him and should have some residual fitness. Won't be far away. ACHY BREAKY (11) bolted in at the trials recently and looks primed for a bold showing on resumption.
